newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in quiet trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0801 per dollar in listless trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0800 per greenback to give liquidity to the market, dealers said.
At 1640 local/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $88 million deficit. But dealers speculated the final figures could show a surplus.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0860 per dollar, 0.02 percent down.
In the parallel market, the real dropped 0.26 percent to end the day at 1.138 per dollar.
